Possible connection between brain and cosmos

The human brain and the cosmos contain complex networks. This article proposes that fractal structures may provide a useful comparison between these systems.

Quantum transport in fractal networks

The linked research studies quantum transport in synthetic fractal photonic networks and reports distinctive transport behaviour caused by their geometry.

Interpretation

The article extends those findings into a speculative discussion about cognition, awareness and cosmic structure. These broader claims require independent verification.
